rows.name: Order without a tender
rows.expression: An order has no tender type, so the payment cannot be matched.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Order without line detail
rows.expression: An order carries no line items, so its items cannot be audited.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Timing autonomy limit
rows.expression: A no-movement timing classification may be permitted without a human only up to this exposure.
rows.description: Sales Audit policy limit read by Nimbus from an approved release.

rows.name: Order with zero or negative amount
rows.expression: An order's amount is zero or negative.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Order with zero or negative quantity
rows.expression: An order's quantity is zero or negative.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: High-value order
rows.expression: An order is above 5000.00 and needs a review. Tune the amount in Studio.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Transaction without a number
rows.expression: A transaction has no transaction number, so it cannot sit in a sequence.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Refund without a reason
rows.expression: A refund has no return reason.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Transaction not in USD
rows.expression: A transaction is not in USD, the currency the audit limits use.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Open store day with no orders
rows.expression: An open store day has no order from the sales feed.
rows.description: Draft Sales Audit transaction rule for the Shopify feed; awaiting data steward approval.

rows.name: Autonomy limit
rows.expression: A recommendation whose financial impact exceeds this amount always needs a human decision.
rows.description: Sales Audit policy limit read by Nimbus from an approved release.

rows.name: Bank variance
